title: Practice Lab: Memory Analysis, Hashing & Timeline Forensic Reconstruction

steps.title: Verify Evidence SHA-256 Hash Integrity
steps.instruction: Compute the SHA-256 cryptographic hash of evidence file 'evidence_mem.raw' using sha256sum to ensure zero alteration.
steps.hint: Run sha256sum evidence_mem.raw in the terminal.

steps.title: Analyze Memory Dump with Volatility 3
steps.instruction: Run Volatility to inspect process tree and identify suspicious PowerShell child processes in the memory dump.

steps.title: Network Sockets Forensic Scan
steps.instruction: Extract active TCP/UDP network connections from memory to locate C2 server communication sockets.
